chunks: Ali ibn Ibrahim, from his father, from Safwan ibn Yahya, from Ays ibn al-Qasim, who said:
I asked Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) about drinking the milk of donkeys, so he (peace be upon him) said: 'Drink it'.
ai.seo_question: Is it permissible to drink donkey milk according to Shia hadith?
ai.summary: Recorded in Al-Kafi by Ays ibn al-Qasim, this hadith establishes the permissibility (jawaaz) of consuming donkey milk through Imam al-Sadiq’s (AS) direct affirmation. While the Prophet Muhammad (PBUH) generally prohibited the meat of domestic donkeys, the scholars distinguish this from their milk, which is considered pure (tahir) and beneficial, reflecting the Shia principle of default permissibility for foodstuffs unless explicitly forbidden.

en.hubeali: Ali Bin Ibrahim, from his father, from Safwan Bin Yahya, from Ays Bin Al Qasim who said,
‘I asked Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> about drinking the yoghurt milk. So he<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘Drink it’.
en.sarwar: 3. Ali ibn Ibrahim has narrated from his father from Safwan ibn Yahya from ‘Is ibn al-Qasim who has said the following ‘I once asked abu ‘Abd Allah, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, about drinking yogurt water.
He (the Imam) said, ‘You can drink it.’”
